name: ONE VERSE
_why: The first deck of the 0z metaverse. It is deliberately almost empty: a sea, one island, and numbered plots. Everything else is meant to be built by whoever arrives, not by us.

origin.label: the 0
origin.what: the one point nobody can derive. The island is built around it and the beacon sits on it.

island.label: the island
island.what: the only land. Small on purpose: land is where a claim becomes visible.

plots.when: the archive — where a record is kept
the workshop — where a thing is built
the school — where a newcomer is taught the four laws
the market — where a price becomes citable
the gate — the only door, and it only opens inward
the empty seat — six are built, the seventh stays vacant until someone arrives, and then it is theirs

rules: A claim is a row: plot, who, note, timestamp. Nothing is claimed by drawing over someone.
The public gate is read-only and always will be: POST there returns E_WORLD_READ_ONLY.
Claims are appended by the defender gate, never edited, never removed.
The zero at the centre belongs to nobody. It is where counting starts, not where someone lives.
